versions.changelog:
- Initial release of yzj-form-parser.
- Supports parsing and building YunZhijia form data structures, including both data push parsing and approval initiation.
- Handles main form controls and detail table controls, covering various widget types: text, single/multi-select, date, person, department, detail tables, attachments, images, etc.
- Provides field explanations, common data structures, and code examples for both parsing and constructing form data.
- Includes reference links for widget types and detail table structures.
